prompt: Create ONE high-resolution panoramic architectural editorial photograph, an ultra-wide 4:1 website banner for an About Us page of a modern European independent car dealership. Distinctive scene: a tasteful modest contemporary showroom viewed diagonally from a quiet lounge corner, beautifully detailed black-framed floor-to-ceiling glass on the right, pale stone floor, soft daylight, a simple charcoal lounge chair and small olive tree at the far LEFT, one or two realistically SMALL silver/graphite vehicles deeper inside at the far RIGHT. Architecture and calm welcoming space are the main subject; cars are background scale, not giant vehicle cutouts. An understated pale plaster partition and soft daylight provide a calm, naturally light central 55 percent for a centered black title, small location label and two buttons. Draw beautiful long architectural lines across the image, coherent perspective, honest material textures and restrained reflections. All major subjects must fit within the central horizontal band so it crops well to a 1345 by 352 banner. Neutral graphite, pearl white, pale stone, slight warm natural accents. Photograph suitable for a design magazine, authentic rather than ostentatious. No people, no dealer name, no signs, no words, no logos, no watermarks, no two giant cars on opposite edges, no showroom front-quarter advertising composition, no CGI, no glossy sci-fi showroom, no dramatic coloured lighting. One continuous photograph, not a collage or contact sheet. Very wide horizontal image.
